data.exact_reserve_text: During 2020 the Syndicate released $74.5m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2019: $38.3m), arising predominantly from the Marine, Energy and Treaty divisions (2018: primarily from the Marine, Energy and Property Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on prior year losses during 2020.

data.standardized_narrative: For the year ended 31 December 2020 Syndicate 1084 reported an opening gross claims outstanding of $2,645.3m and recorded a net prior-year release of technical reserves amounting to $74.5m (gross), primarily driven by favourable claims development on prior year losses. The releases arose predominantly within the Marine, Energy and Treaty divisions. The Syndicate nevertheless experienced catastrophe activity in 2020 (notably Hurricanes Laura, Zeta, Sally and Delta and the Midwest Derecho) and retained exposures from significant 2019 events (Typhoons Faxai and Hagibis and Hurricane Dorian).
raw_causal_phrases: During 2020 the Syndicate released $74.5m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2019: $38.3m), arising predominantly from the Marine, Energy and Treaty divisions (2018: primarily from the Marine, Energy and Property Divisions).
These releases were due to favourable claims development on prior year losses during 2020.
The underwriting result did benefit from more favourable prior year development than 2019 with significant releases on a number of large risk losses following favourable settlements.

data.data_quality_notes: All amounts are reported in the syndicate's native currency (USD). Prior year development figure taken from Note '4. Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which explicitly states a $74.5m release (gross) and is used as the primary source. Claims development triangle and technical reserves tables were used for cross-checking. The syndicate undertook Part VII transfers and a contract replacement (reclassification) during the period which affect presentation and may distort some comparative classifications (see notes on Part VII and contract replacement). Where LOB-level PYD amounts are not given, movements are recorded as direction-only with null amounts.
